Monthly earnings calculation filters by current month start date
Create-manager and create-team-leader endpoints properly validate email uniqueness

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three bug fixes verified: 1) System earnings endpoint (/api/crm/system-earnings) returns total_earnings=37500 and monthly_earnings=0 with 10 commissions. 2) Admin can create managers and team leaders via Users tab with Add Manager/Add Team Leader buttons. 3) Disbursed reversal logic is implemented in crm.py update_eligibilities function - when disbursed changes from 'yes' to 'no', commission is deducted from agent/partner earnings.
